_comment: Used by lib/scorer.js to label each job with a role track. Pass 1 is a title keyword match. Pass 2 cross-checks with skill-keyword overlap; if they disagree, the job is flagged for manual review instead of a silent guess. This file is the only place CV file names live: the dashboard's Download CV button reads it. All tracks share one resume for now; give a track its own PDF any time by changing its resumeFile and putting that PDF in resumes/.
notes: fullstack is the default track (general software engineer roles). Titles are checked in order: infrastructure, then backend, then fullstack, so 'Platform Engineer' is Infrastructure and 'Python Software Engineer' is Backend.
